findReplace.surface: Localized two-row panel in text/JSON/raw-table detail windows

native.detailTitleInput: Shared TextInputSurface: 38pt high, 10pt horizontal padding, no resting outline; 1.5pt graphite rounded focus border instead of native blue inner ring. 19pt semibold title.

cardActions.geometry: 28x28pt square, 6pt radius, 6pt gap, zero alignment insets
cardActions.behavior: Actions target the clicked card UUID. Delete disabled while its source is processing; removal and duplication share existing undo history.

preview.fidelity: Geometry and palette references only. Production uses native AppKit with shared FeedbackButton state rendering; native tracking, actions and accessibility remain authoritative.
preview.tonalRamps: Synthesized OKLCH lightness ramps for documentation only; not production palette tokens.
preview.stateStyles: Browser preview hover/focus/press CSS is an approximation, not shipping AppKit styling. No CSS shadow or blur simulates Liquid Glass.

narrative.overview:
Jot gives text, data and files a spacious native Mac workbench. The confirmed gray-white direction appears in an adaptive graphite identity, a translucent sidebar, opaque content cards and native glass controls. The Jot name and user-selected dot-and-lowercase-j silhouette remain the identity anchors.

The free canvas makes sources and results visible together. Compact navigation and contextual tools leave room for movable cards; separate detail windows give editing and previewing focused space. System typography, AppKit window chrome and native text interactions determine the feel.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral gray-white surfaces with adaptive charcoal counterparts.
Opaque cards on a scrollable, magnifiable canvas.
Native glass navigation and contextual controls.
Visible card selection, source context and local-save status.

rules.name: The Appearance Pair Rule
rules.body: Apply light and dark values by semantic role through native appearance resolution; do not freeze the app to a single screenshot's palette.

rules.name: The Native Material Rule
rules.body: Let AppKit own glass composition, highlights, shadows, focus, hover and pressed rendering. Documentation snippets illustrate geometry and palette only; they do not reproduce native materials.

dos: **Do** preserve the Jot name and user-selected dot-and-lowercase-j silhouette.
**Do** keep gray-white surfaces and adaptive charcoal counterparts.
**Do** reserve glass for navigation and controls while keeping content cards opaque.
**Do** keep drag handles, resize grips and selection outlines visible.
**Do** use native windows and controls for detail editing, preview and system actions.
**Do** show processing state, result provenance and save failures in clear text.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded sage palette or add stationery textures.
**Don't** replace the native Mac implementation with a web shell or mobile layout.
**Don't** invent exact glass colors, decorative card shadows or production CSS blur.
**Don't** describe read-only previews as editable grids or claim direct editing of arbitrary files.
**Don't** treat documentation panel previews as native rendering or older-OS validation.
